Contact

Talk to the house.

Questions about a piece, an invoice or a partner offer can be sent by email. AURA answers from a monitored inbox, normally within two working days.

About an order

Include the invoice reference from your checkout confirmation. That reference points to the request saved in your browser and makes the reply quicker.

About a piece

Send the product name and the question. Origin, material and care details already known are printed on the product page; anything still being confirmed is answered directly.

About the library

Perennis questions, edition notes and rights enquiries are welcome. A title is published only when the exact edition and the permission behind it are documented.
